title: First ropeway to Owakudani · pirate ship across Lake Ashi · lakeside torii · castle-villa lunch · Glass no Mori lights · Sengokuhara sushi · snack-bar karaoke

stops.name: Hot Spring Hakone Villa
stops.plan: Konbini breakfast from last night's haul and a quick morning soak; dress warm, Owakudani is cold and windy.

stops.name: Hakone Ropeway Togendai → Owakudani
stops.plan: First car up (December service 9:00–16:15, Freepass); sit facing the lake for Fuji. The Owakudani–Sōunzan leg beyond is a replacement bus 7–24 Dec, so we only ride up and back.

stops.name: Owakudani & black eggs
stops.plan: Sulphur vents and the clearest Fuji views of the day; kuro-tamago black eggs and souvenir shopping at the station shop.
stops.transport: Hakone Ropeway Owakudani → Togendai, about 25 min (Freepass)

stops.name: Pirate ship Togendai → Motohakone
stops.plan: Next winter-schedule sailing from Togendai (Freepass; winter crossings run slower); deck up top for the lake and Fuji.
stops.transport: Walk along the lakeshore to Hakone Shrine, 6 min

stops.name: Hakone Shrine & Torii of Peace
stops.plan: Cedar-lined steps to the shrine, then shoot the lakeside torii from the side path instead of the midday photo queue.

stops.name: Albergo Bamboo
stops.plan: Booked upstairs private room for 8 in the castle-style villa: uni-lemon cream pasta, winter boar, a bottle of prosecco.
stops.transport: Walk to Hakone Glass no Mori, 9 min

stops.name: Hakone Glass no Mori Christmas illumination
stops.plan: Venetian glass garden and crystal arches; stay past sunset (~16:30) for the glass Christmas tree and candles (lit 1–25 Dec).

stops.name: A-Coop Sengokuhara
stops.plan: Before the 18:00 close: tomorrow's breakfast plus cans, chu-hi and sake for the villa (Yamakawaya is shut on Sundays).

stops.name: Hakone Sushi
stops.plan: Booked tatami room for 8 (phone 0460-84-7890): special chirashi, uni-ikura bowls, anago and local sake.

stops.name: Snack Takachan & Maron
stops.plan: Book the night before: mama-san snack bar with karaoke, ask for a set price for 8 and a lift back to the villa.
stops.transport: Taxi or the bar's lift to the villa, 6 min

stops.name: Hot Spring Hakone Villa
stops.plan: Last soak and nightcaps; pack tonight, check-out is 10:00 tomorrow.
